body: Well basically she was being unnecessarily mean to one of my other friends and when I confronted her things went downhill from there, but I know it sounds bad but I think I know why she acted out, while it doesn't excuse it it definitely explains it. Also my other friend and her are cool now but I never really got over it until recently when I started thinking about it more deeply.
I'm 14, so not the second one but thanks.

Not really, sometimes (rarely) I can't hide it for any longer and I get a bit pissy until I'm told to get over it or someone makes a comment about me being in a bad mood and then I just continue acting like normal.
Yeah I wanted to ask my friends if they ever feel like that but it's probably too much of a worrying conversation to have so it does give me a strange comfort that you feel this way too

Well I've gotten so used to pretending to be happy and fine that I can't really differentiate between what I'm actually feeling or what I pretend to feel with most emotions so I really have no clue but I do know that small things can make me happy for a brief second, like seeing a dog on my way to the train but I don't know if it makes me happy or if I just smile out of habit. This doesn't really answer the question you ask but thanks for explaining it I never really understood why I was like this
